licenses.name: CC BY 4.0
licenses.source: GEMET 4.2.3 RDF and versioned download page

boundary.source_named_graphs: both source RDF documents are un-named; importer union is explicit

adequacy.bounded_bilingual_taxonomy_study: suitable, subject to exploratory human-review limits
adequacy.heterogeneous_relation_learning: not representative: three named relations and 5,681 broader/narrower reciprocal pairs
adequacy.selection_rationale: largest retained licensed real graph with substantial connected bilingual typed edges; no synthetic load data used

richer_mission_candidate.source: Wikidata Query Service, bounded Norway organization extract
richer_mission_candidate.selection: First 1,000 results ordered by item IRI with direct P17=Norway and direct P31=Organization; retain all direct claims from those subjects whose objects are Wikidata Q entities, plus en/no/nb/nn labels. No inverse or inferred edges.

assessment.organization_entity_relationship_pilot: better scoped than GEMET and adequate for a bounded exploratory baseline/training trial
assessment.service_operator_questions: insufficient: only one P137 operator edge; add a service-focused selection before claiming coverage
assessment.sampling_limit: The 1,000-root IRI-order cap is deterministic but not representative; broad generalization is not supported
assessment.label_coverage_limit: 90 of 2,157 entity nodes have no retained en/no/nb/nn label; preserve their IDs and report the feature fallback
assessment.source_provenance_limit: Wikidata statements are community-maintained and the bounded query snapshot is time-specific; query and response hashes bind this capture
